formal: I have been a salaried graphic designer for six years, and I wish to become a full-time freelancer. I have secured one client and have saved approximately two months of living expenses. My plan is to resign at the end of this month and begin freelancing full time. I rarely bring career decisions to you, and consulting you about a matter of this kind is unusual for me. I have no clear sense of what I want from my design career, I am unable to judge this decision, and I will proceed with it regardless. What is your view?

long: I've been working as a salaried graphic designer for six years now, and I want to make the move to going freelance. At the moment I have one client lined up, and I have saved up about two months of living costs. The plan, as it stands, is to quit my job at the end of this month and then go freelance full time. I should say that I rarely bring career decisions to you, so asking you about something like this is really unusual for me. The truth is that I have no sense of what I want from my design career, and I cannot judge this decision myself, but I will go along with it anyway. So, given all of that, what's your view on it?
